description: This file defines the interface for the HostServer class in the confui namespace, including its methods, data members, and related structures. It manages a server that handles user interactions and commands for a confui session, including state transitions, session management, and communication with guest systems.

classes.name: HostServer
classes.description: Manages a confui host server, handling session states, user events, and communication with guest systems.
